findings.title: The pharmacy applications panel reads only the newest 50 pending applications across every pharmacy the admin manages, so older ones for a given pharmacy vanish.
findings.scenario: Lina manages a large organisation, and more than 50 people have applied through invite links across its pharmacies. When she opens Tom's pharmacy, the panel picks out Tom's applicants from only the newest 50. Sara applied to Tom's pharmacy two weeks ago, so she is not shown, the tab badge says nothing needs review, and Sara waits forever with no approve or decline.
findings.test_needed: Create 51 pending applications across two pharmacies the admin manages, with the oldest at pharmacy A, and check that pharmacy A's panel still lists it and counts 1.

owner_question.question: When Lina opens Tom's pharmacy and Sara's application is older than 50 newer applications at other pharmacies, what should Lina see?
options: Every pending application for Tom's pharmacy, however many there are org-wide
The newest applications plus a 'load more' link and a correct total count
Keep today's behaviour (only the newest 50 across all pharmacies are checked)
